kebab_example: aliyun ice create-vod-packaging-configuration --group-name vod_hls --configuration-name hls_3s --protocol HLS --description HLS_3s_vod_packaging --package-config '{"ManifestName":"index","StreamSelection":{"MinVideoBitsPerSecond":100000,"StreamOrder":"ORIGINAL","MaxVideoBitsPerSecond":1000000000},"DrmProvider":{"SystemIds":["94ce86fb-07ff-4f43-adb8-93d2fa968ca2"],"EncryptionMethod":"AES_128","IV":"00001111222233334444555566667777","Url":"https://000drm000/getcontent"},"SegmentDuration":6}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVodPackagingConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The name of the packaging group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) are supported
parameters.help_zh: 点播打包组名称，长度128个字符，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the packaging configuration. The name must be unique in an account and can be up to 128 characters in length. Letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) are supported
parameters.help_zh: 点播打包配置名称，长度128个字符，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+，用户维度唯一
parameters.name: configuration_name

parameters.help_en:
The package type.

- HLS: packages content into TS segments for delivery over the HLS protocol.

- HLS\_CMAF: packages content into CMAF segments for delivery over the HLS protocol.

- DASH: packages content for delivery over the DASH protocol
parameters.help_zh:
点播打包类型，支持：
- HLS: HLC协议播放格式；
- HLS_CMAF： HLS协议的CMAF播放格式；
- DASH: DASH协议播放格式
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The description of the packaging configuration
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The manifest name. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) are supported
fields.name: manifest_name

fields.help_en: The duration of each segment in a packaged stream. Unit: seconds. MediaPackage rounds segments to the nearest multiple of the input segment duration. Valid values: 1 to 30
fields.help_zh: 每个片段的时长（以秒为单位）。实际片段将会被四舍五入到最接近的源片段时长的倍数。取值范围【1，30】
fields.name: segment_duration

fields.help_en: The minimum bitrate of the video stream. Unit: bit/s
fields.name: min_video_bits_per_second

fields.help_en: The maximum bitrate of the video stream. Unit: bit/s
fields.name: max_video_bits_per_second

fields.help_en:
The order of manifest files in the master playlist. Valid values:

- ORIGINAL: sorts the manifest files in the same order as the source.

- VIDEO\_BITRATE\_ASCENDING: sorts the manifest files in ascending order of bitrates, from lowest to highest.

- VIDEO\_BITRATE\_DESCENDING: sorts the manifest files in descending order of bitrates, from highest to lowest
fields.help_zh:
流排序规则，支持值：
- ORIGINAL：保持输入序号；
- VIDEO_BITRATE_ASCENDING：按视频流码率递增；
- VIDEO_BITRATE_DESCENDING：按视频流码率递减
fields.name: stream_order

fields.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:

- AES\_128: Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) with 128-bit key length.

- SAMPLE\_AES: an encryption method that encrypts individual media samples
fields.help_zh:
加密算法，支持值：
- AES_128：128位高级加密标准；
- SAMPLE_AES：媒体内容保护领域的一个特定实现方式，抽样加密
fields.name: encryption_method

fields.help_en: A 128-bit, 16-byte hex value represented by a 32-character string that is used with the key for encrypting data blocks. If you leave this parameter empty, MediaPackage creates a constant initialization vector (IV). If it is specified, the value is passed to the DRM service
fields.help_zh: 一个可选的128位（16字节）十六进制值，由32个字符的字符串表示，与密钥一起用于加密数据块。如果您不指定该值，则MediaPackage将创建一个常量初始化向量（IV）。默认值：空，如果填写，则透传到供应商Constant initialization vector
fields.name: iv

fields.help_en:
The ID of the DRM system. The maximum number of system IDs allowed is determined by the protocol type. Limits:

- DASH: 2

- HLS: 1

- HLS\_CMAF: 2

Apple FairPlay, Google Widevine, and Microsoft PlayReady are supported. Their system IDs are as follows:

- Apple FairPlay: 94ce86fb-07ff-4f43-adb8-93d2fa968ca2

- Google Widevine: edef8ba9-79d6-4ace-a3c8-27dcd51d21e

- Microsoft PlayReady: 9a04f079-9840-4286-ab92-e65be0885f95
fields.help_zh:
DRM 系统id，system id数量由使用的协议类型决定，具体限制：
- DASH -- 最多两个；
- HLS -- 提供一个；
- HLS_CMAF-- 最多提供两个。

目前支持 Apple FairPlay、Google Widevine、Microsoft PlayReady 三个DRM System，对应SystemId分别为 ：
- Apple FairPlay：94ce86fb-07ff-4f43-adb8-93d2fa968ca2；
- Google Widevine：edef8ba9-79d6-4ace-a3c8-27dcd51d21e；
- Microsoft PlayReady：9a04f079-9840-4286-ab92-e65be0885f95
fields.name: system_ids

fields.help_en: The URL of the DRM key provider
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The settings of digital rights management (DRM) encryption
fields.name: drm_provider
